## Publication checklist

- [ ] The sample is self-contained and documented.
- [ ] Credentials and resource-specific values are not committed.
- [ ] Checked-in links and content are suitable for a public repository.
- [ ] Tests or documented validation steps pass.
- [ ] The root sample catalog is updated when applicable.
- [ ] New third-party dependencies have compatible licenses.
